meta.notes: A potion of a vanilla effect that has no vanilla potion: Levitation for 10 seconds. brewing.reagent names the project item msm_examples:moon_shard, so an awkward potion and a moon shard brew it; strong adds msm_examples:strong_levitation (Levitation II for 5 seconds, brewed with glowstone dust). lingering false leaves out the lingering bottle, and with it the tipped arrows; the splash bottle stays.
